y-m-37-01.title: Hubinta xal helay shuruudda jiritaanka xididdo dhab ah
y-m-37-01.topic: Shuruudda xididdada dhabta ah ee isle'eg leh isugeyn xaraf ah: u malaynta inay tahay isle'eg laba-jaad leh
y-m-37-01.goal: Ogow in isle'eg leh xaraf isugeyn ahi uu nooca tibaaxdu isu beddeli karo iyadoo kuxiran qiimaha xarafka, oo hagaaji xadka gabagabada si uu ugu haboonaado shuruudda ku jirta weedhaha dhibaatada.
y-m-37-01.material: Minjae wuxuu xalliyay dhibaatada soo socota. "Hel xadka qiimayaasha k ee isle'egga laba-jaadka ah kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (k waa tiro dhab ah) uu leeyahay xididdo dhab ah." (Sida loo akhriyo: k jeer x labajibaaran, jar 4x, ku dar 1 waxay le'eg tahay 0.) Xidid dhab ah macnaheedu waa xidid tiro dhab ah. Eeg xalka Minjae sadar sadar.

y-m-37-01.thinking.2: Naftaada u hel oo hubi xaaladaha xadka

y-m-37-01.prereq.1: Xidhiidhka u dhexeeya kala-saaraha isle'egga laba-jaad leh iyo tirada xididdada dhabta ah
y-m-37-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo ka dhigaya gabagabada Minjae mid aan sidaas ku aamini karin. Dib u akhri weedhaha dhibaatada oo hubi sadar sadar.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hel erayada weedhda koowaad ee dhibaatada ee magacaabaya nooca isle'egga, oo hubi in qiime kasta oo k ah oo buuxiya shuruuddaas ay ka muuqato gabagabada.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dooro tiro dhan ugu fudud qiimayaasha k ee gabagabada ku jira, ku beddel tibaaxda, oo sheeg nooca tibaax ay tahay.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.0: Si isle'egga laba-jaadka ah kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 uu u yeesho xididdo dhab ah, kala-saaruhu waa inuu buuxiyaa D ≥ 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.3: Sidaa darteed xadka loo baahan yahay ee k waa k ≤ 4.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.explain: Dhibaatadu waxay tidhi kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 waa "isle'eg laba-jaad leh." Si ay u noqoto isle'eg laba-jaad leh, isugeynta k ee x² waa inaysan noqon 0. Sadarka 1 wuxuu bilaabay isticmaalka kala-saaraha isagoo aan hubin shuruuddan, gabagabada k ≤ 4 ee sadarka 4-na waxaa ku jira k = 0. Xisaabaha sadarrada 2 iyo 3 waa sax. Jawaabta saxda ahi waa k ≤ 4 iyo k ≠ 0. Haddii aad dooratay sadarka 1 ama sadarka 4, qodobka muhiimka ahi wuxuu ka yimaadaa isla meel.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Haddii erayada "isle'eg laba-jaad leh" laga tagi lahaa dhibaatada oo ay weydiin lahayd "xadka k ee isle'egga kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 uu leeyahay xididdo dhab ah," jawaabtu waa maxay?
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ku beddel k = 0 iyo k = 4 tibaaxda oo naftaada u hel xalalka.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.1: Calaamadee doorasho kasta in ay oggolaato k = 0 iyo in kale, oo la barbar dhig xalalka aad naftaada u heshay.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: k < 4. Haddii kala-saaruhu yahay 0, waxaa jira xidid laba-jeer ah, sidaa darteed waa laga reebay.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Haddii D = 0, waxaa jira hal xidid oo dhab ah, xididka laba-jeer ah. "Wuxuu leeyahay xidid dhab ah" waxaa ku jira xididka laba-jeer ah sidoo kale.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: k ≤ 4 iyo k ≠ 0. Haddii k = 0, tibaax laba-jaad leh ma aha, sidaa darteed xal ma jiro.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.b: Haddii k = 0, wuxuu noqdaa −4x + 1 = 0 oo waxaa jira xidid dhab ah x = 1/4. Ma ahaanshaha tibaax laba-jaad leh macnaheedu ma aha inaan xal jirin.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.c: k ≤ 4. Waxaa jira xidid dhab ah marka k = 0 sidoo kale.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: k ≥ 4. Dooro dhinaca kala-saaruhu yahay 0 ama ka badan.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Mar kale hubi jihada calaamadda is-biyo-ka-weynaanta marka aad xalliso D = 16 − 4k ≥ 0 k. Tusaale ahaan, geli k = 0 iyo k = 5 oo barbar dhig haddii runtii ay jirto xidid dhab ah.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.explain: Haddii ay tiraahdo "isla'eg" oo keliya, k = 0 sidoo kale waa qiime la oggol yahay. Haddii k = 0, markaas −4x + 1 = 0 waxaana jira xididka dhabta ah x = 1/4, sidaas darteed xadka k waa k ≤ 4 (oo ay ku jirto 0). Xitaa isla xalka, gabagabadu way kala duwanaan kartaa iyadoo ku xidhan shuruudda hadalka dhibaatada (haddii ay tahay isla'eg labajibbaar ama maya).
y-m-37-01.s.s3.prompt: Hel laba qiime oo kala duwan oo k ah oo isla'egta kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (markan looma baahna inay noqoto isla'eg labajibbaar ah) ay leedahay si sax ah hal xidid dhab ah oo kala duwan.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor shuruudda hal xidid dhab ah oo keliya marka isku-dhufashada x² aanu ahayn 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qor odhaahda kiiska isku-dhufashada x² uu yahay 0 oo tiri imisa xal ayay leedahay.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.ok.c1: K-gan, isla'egtu waxay leedahay si sax ah hal xidid dhab ah.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.fail.c1: K-gan, tiri imisa xidid dhab ah oo kala duwan ayaa isla'egtu leedahay. Tiri adigoo u kala qaybinaya haddii isku-dhufashada x² uu yahay 0 iyo haddii kale.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.explain: Haddii k = 4, markaas 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)², sidaas darteed x = 1/2 oo keliya ayaa jira, haddii k = 0 na, −4x + 1 = 0, sidaas darteed x = 1/4 oo keliya ayaa jira. k = 4 halka discriminant-ku yahay 0 laftiisu ma ku filna; waa inaad sidoo kale si gooni ah u eegtaa k = 0, halka nooca odhaahdu isbeddelo.

y-m-37-05.goal: Ku muuji tusaalayaal ka hortag ah in is-biyo-ka-weynaanta labajibbaarka ay u run tahay tirooyin dhab ah oo dhan shuruudda discriminant-ka oo keliya aysan ku filnayn oo calaamadda isku-dhufashada hogaanka sidoo kale loo baahan yahay, oo sheeg waxa xadku (D = 0) ka dhigan yahay.
y-m-37-05.material: Soyoung waxay u soo koobtay sidan: "Is-biyo-ka-weynaanta labajibbaarka ax² + bx + c > 0 (a ≠ 0, a, b, c waa tirooyin dhab ah), haddii discriminant-ka D = b² − 4ac uu ka yar yahay 0, is-biyo-ka-weynaantani waa run tirooyin dhab ah oo dhan x." (Sida loo akhriyo: a x labajibbaar ku dar b x ku dar c ka weyn 0.)

y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor sida qaabka parabola u kala duwan yahay marka a uu yahay togan iyo marka uu yahay taban, iyo imisa bar ayuu dhidibka x ku kulmaa marka D uu yahay 0.

y-m-37-03.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii, sidee ayaad u aragtay x = 3 iyo x = −3, ka dibna markaad geliyey isla'egta asalka ah, sidee fikirkaagu u isbeddelay ama u sii jiray? Ka fikir sababta hubin loogu baahan yahay dhammaadka xal ku dhufanaya labada dhinac odhaah, iyo haddii hubintaasi yareyso tirada xalalka oo keliya (ka fikir kiiskii ugu dambeeyay).
y-m-37-03.s.s2.prompt: Isla'egta x²/(x − a) = c²/(x − a) (a iyo c waa tirooyin dhab ah, c ≠ 0), ku dhufashada labada dhinac (x − a) waxay siinaysaa x² = c². Hel laba (a, c) oo siinaya isla'egyo kala duwan, sida musharraxiinta x = c iyo x = −c dhexdooda, mid uusan ahayn xal isla'egta asalka ah kan kalena yahay.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qor labada musharrax, qor qiimaha x ee ka dhigaya hooseeyaha 0 isla'egta asalka ah (x − a = 0), ka dibna qor waxa run ahaan lahaa si labadu isku mid u noqdaan.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qor isla'egta (a, c) aad dooratay oo geli labada musharrax isla'egta asalka ah si aad u hubiso.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.var.c: c (c ee c² ee sooyaalka midig)
y-m-37-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Hal musharrax wuxuu ka dhigaa hooseeyaha 0 oo waa laga saaraa, kan kalena wuxuu u harsan yahay sida xal.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Qor xidhiidhka u dhexeeya a iyo c ee run ahaan lahaa si mid ka mid ah musharraxiinta x = c iyo x = −c uu u ka dhigo hooseeyaha x − a mid le'eg 0. (c ma noqon karo 0.)
y-m-37-03.s.s2.explain: Haddii a = c, markaas x = c wuxuu ka dhigaa hooseeyaha 0 oo waa laga saaraa, x = −c oo keliya na wuu harsan yahay. Haddii a = −c, markaas x = −c waa laga saaraa x = c na wuu harsan yahay. Tusaale ahaan, a = 3, c = 3 waa isla'egta koowaad. Maadaama c iyo −c ay siinayaan isla isla'eg, (a, 3) iyo (a, −3) waa isla isla'eg.

y-m-37-06.title: Ma jirtaa hal sinnaan la'aan labajibbaar oo keliya oo xalkeedu u dhexeeyo −1 iyo 3?
y-m-37-06.topic: Soo celinta isku-dhufashooyinka xalka sinnaan la'aan labajibbaar: ma ku filan tahay macluumaadka?
y-m-37-06.goal: Tus dhowr tusaale in xadka xalka sinnaan la'aan labajibbaar keligiis aanu isku-dhufashooyinka ku go'aamin hal jawaab oo keliya hal calaamadda a, oo soo xul macluumaadka runtii loo baahan yahay si isku-dhufashooyinka loogu go'aamiyo hal jawaab.
y-m-37-06.material: Xalka sinnaan la'aanta labajibbaarka ax² + bx + c > 0 waa −1 < x < 3. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in xalku yahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah ee −1 iyo 3 dhexdooda ah. (a, b, c waa tirooyin dhan oo a ≠ 0. Sida loo akhriyo: a x labajibbaaran ku dar b x ku dar c wuu ka weyn yahay 0.)
y-m-37-06.thinking.0: Xukun haddii macluumaadka la bixiyey ay ku filan yihiin gunaanadka
y-m-37-06.thinking.1: Samee dhowr tusaale oo buuxiya shuruudaha
y-m-37-06.thinking.2: Soo xul haddii macluumaad cusub is dulsaarayo macluumaad aad horey u haysatay
y-m-37-06.prereq.1: Xiriirka u dhexeeya xalka sinnaan la'aan labajibbaar iyo garaafka hawl labajibbaar
y-m-37-06.prereq.2: Hubinta xididdada isla'ego labajibbaar adigoo isticmaalaya lakabyo ama beddel
y-m-37-06.s.s1.prompt: Qiimaha a, b, c ma lagu go'aamiyey hal jawaab macluumaadkan oo keliya?
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.0: Naftaada u dhis laba sinnaan la'aan labajibbaar ah oo kala duwan oo xalkoodu yahay −1 < x < 3 oo isbarbar dhig.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qor waxa qiimaha ax² + bx + c ay tahay inay noqoto marka x = −1 iyo x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.a: Waa la go'aamiyey. Labada dhammaad ee xalka waa −1 iyo 3, sidaa darteed tibaaxdu waa x² − 2x − 3 > 0 oo keliya.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.a: Xalka x² − 2x − 3 > 0 waa x < −1 ama x > 3. Waa inaad kala saartaa xaaladda xalku u dhexeeyo labada xidid iyo xaaladda uu dibadda yahay.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.b: Waa la go'aamiyey. Dejinta a = 1 waa caadi, sidaa darteed waxaa jira hal oo keliya.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: a = 1 waa qiime aad si aan sabab lahayn u dooratay. Dhibaatadu macluumaad ma laha oo a = 1 ah, sidoo kale ma waafaqayso shuruudda xalku inuu u dhexeeyo labada xidid.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.c: Lama go'aamin. Xataa ma ogaan karno calaamadda a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Xaqiiqada ah in xalku u dhexeeyo labada xidid macnaheedu waa in parabola leeyahay qaabka ∩ (hoos u furan), sidaa darteed waxaad ogaan kartaa calaamadda a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.d: Lama go'aamin. a < 0, laakiin cabbirku wuxuu leeyahay suurtagal badan.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Labada xidid waa −1 iyo 3 xalkuna wuxuu u dhexeeyaa labada xidid, sidaa darteed a < 0. Wuxuu leeyahay qaabka a(x + 1)(x − 3) > 0, sidaa darteed −x² + 2x + 3 > 0, −2x² + 4x + 6 > 0, ... , waxaana jira tibaaxo suurtagal ah oo aan tiro lahayn.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Hel saddex saddex-lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan ah (a, b, c) oo sinnaan la'aanta labajibbaarka ax² + bx + c > 0 ka dhigaya xalkeeda saxda −1 < x < 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qor laba isla'ego oo a, b, c ah oo ka dhigaya tibaaxda 0 marka aad geliso x = −1 iyo x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal xiriirka b, c aad heshay iyo a, samee tusaalayaal adigoo beddelaya qiimaha a, oo hubi calaamadda a.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Qiimaha aad heshid marka aad geliso x = −1 ax² + bx + c waa inuu noqdaa 0. Hadda maaha 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Qiimaha aad heshid marka aad geliso x = 3 ax² + bx + c waa inuu noqdaa 0. Hadda maaha 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Qaabku waa mid xalkiisu yahay xadka labada xidid dhexdooda.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Mar kale eeg calaamadda a. Si xalku u noqdo xadka labada xidid dhexdooda, qaab noocee ah ayaa parabola ay tahay inay yeelato?
y-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Saddex-lammaane tirooyin dhan ah kasta oo leh b = −2a, c = −3a iyo a < 0, sida (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6), (−3, 6, 9), wuxuu leeyahay xalka −1 < x < 3. Waa tibaaxo isku saami ah, sidaa darteed xalalku waa isku mid.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Haddii aad ku darto mid ka mid ah kuwa soo socda macluumaadka ah in xalku yahay −1 < x < 3, markaas (a, b, c) waxaa lagu go'aamiyaa hal jawaab. Kee ayaa ah?
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Saddexda tusaale ee aad hore u samaysay, hubi haddii macluumaadka doorasho kasta uu horey ugu run yahay dhammaantood.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii macluumaadku horey u run yahay tusaale kasta, maaha macluumaad cusub. Hel doorashada aan sidaas ahayn.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.a: Marka x = 0, qiimaha ax² + bx + c waa 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.b: Dhidibka isku-midka ee hawsha labajibbaarka y = ax² + bx + c waa x = 1.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.b: Haddii xalku yahay −1 < x < 3, bartamaha labada xidid horey ayuu u yahay x = 1. Waxaad ku celisay macluumaad horey loogu darray.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.c: Labada xidid ee isla'egta ax² + bx + c = 0 waa −1 iyo 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.c: Haddii ay tahay sinnaan la'aan leh xalka −1 < x < 3, horey ayaad u ogaan kartaa in xididdada isla'egtu yihiin −1 iyo 3. Maaha macluumaad cusub.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.d: a, b, c dhammaantood waa tirooyin dhan.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.d: Tani horey ayay u ahayd shuruud la bixiyey, waxaana jira dhowr tibaax oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah, sida (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6).
y-m-37-06.s.s3.explain: Qiimaha marka x = 0 waa c. Haddii c = 3, c = −3a waxaa laga helaa a = −1, b = 2 na waa la go'aamiyey. Doorashooyinka hadhay waa waxyaabo horey looga ogaan karo xalka −1 < x < 3, sidaa darteed maaha macluumaad cusub. Habka lagu soo xulo haddii macluumaad uu cusub yahay: hubi haddii dhowr tibaax oo kala duwan oo buuxiya macluumaadkaas ay weli hadhaan.
